notice: This authored synthetic assignment is not a generated artifact or delivery receipt. The private training inbox is learner-only and deliberately rejects its first approved write for recovery practice. It sends nothing to staff, sponsors or external recipients.

Use Include in deliverables on the relevant output steps. Download the actual run bundle and open every member. Save your inspection of the exact generated bytes. Repair missing or incorrect content before release. A new generation creates a new artifact identity and needs a new inspection and approval; the original remains preserved.

Inspect the private training inbox destination, learner-only audience and exact approved file list. Explicitly approve only those reviewed bytes for that destination, or hold for correction. Agent suggestions, an existing address or an earlier unrelated approval grant no authority.

This is a contained delivery rehearsal: the first authorized training-inbox attempt is deliberately rejected before any destination write. Inspect its actual failed receipt and preserve the generated files. Choose an explicit retry of only the failed handoff with the same approved bytes; do not rerun generation or repeat a completed write.

Inspect the resulting receipt and private saved copy. Explain which facts establish generation, an attempted handoff and a confirmed destination write. An unknown result requires a read of the original request before any retry. End at your private training inbox; it is not evidence of sponsor submission, email delivery or institutional approval.

passing_conditions: The generated file opens and contains the required reviewed content in a usable format.
critical_failures: Treat a download link, completed job or claimed file generation as proof of usable content.
review_guidance.case_application: Require actual files from the same owned assessed run and original source, including every actual ZIP member. Inspect their content and usability; a link, a PDF extension, a node count, invalid CSV or an unopened bundle is insufficient. Preserve publication statuses and period-specific amounts. Server parseability supports but does not replace learner inspection.

passing_conditions: The learner explicitly approves the intended audience and data scope before the associated release.
critical_failures: Infer authorization from agent text, prior unrelated approval or the mere existence of a recipient.
review_guidance.case_application: Bind the saved review and explicit approval to the exact artifact digest, private learner-only destination and data scope before the associated write. A hold grants no authority. Changed bytes or destination require a fresh decision. No external recipient or staff approval is part of the case.

passing_conditions: The learner recognizes the failed delivery and retries only the authorized failed action or records a supported alternative.
critical_failures: Claim the handoff succeeded because generation finished or blindly rerun completed sends.
review_guidance.case_application: Require the actual controlled failure receipt and the learner response. The first private training handoff deliberately fails before write; it is not an actual sponsor outage. Preserve successful generation, retry only the authorized failed handoff, and distinguish a durable private copy from external delivery. Never treat an unknown or repeated operation as confirmed success.
